verdict.rationale: Martin is a SaaS personal assistant, so a public versioned API with a deprecation policy is a fair question for it. The evidence documents only conversational integrations and interfaces (calendar, inbox, Slack, phone/SMS). No public API, API versioning scheme, or deprecation policy appears, and probes for OpenAPI specs all returned 404.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
